title: Challenge #71: Write a function to sort a list of elements using ...
description: Write a function to sort a list of elements using comb sort.
reference_solution:
def comb_sort(nums):
    shrink_fact = 1.3
    gaps = len(nums)
    swapped = True
    i = 0
    while gaps > 1 or swapped:
        gaps = int(float(gaps) / shrink_fact)
        swapped = False
        i = 0
        while gaps + i < len(nums):
            if nums[i] > nums[i+gaps]:
                nums[i], nums[i+gaps] = nums[i+gaps], nums[i]
                swapped = True
            i += 1
    return nums

    arr_len = len(nums)
    while arr_len > 1:
        mi = nums.index(max(nums[0:arr_len]))
        nums = nums[mi::-1] + nums[mi+1:len(nums)]
        nums = nums[arr_len-1::-1] + nums[arr_len:len(nums)]
        arr_len -= 1
    return nums

title: Challenge #179: Write a function to find if the given number is a ...
description: Write a function to find if the given number is a keith number or not.
reference_solution:
def is_num_keith(x): 
	terms = [] 
	temp = x 
	n = 0 
	while (temp > 0): 
		terms.append(temp % 10) 
		temp = int(temp / 10) 
		n+=1 
	terms.reverse() 
	next_term = 0 
	i = n 
	while (next_term < x): 
		next_term = 0 
		for j in range(1,n+1): 
			next_term += terms[i - j] 
		terms.append(next_term) 
		i+=1 
	return (next_term == x)

    b = sl * math.cos(math.radians(30))
    w = b * 2
    h = 2 * sl

    starty = starty - h
    endx = endx + w
    endy = endy + h

    origy = starty
    xoffset = b
    yoffset = 3 * p

    counter = 0

        else:
            startx = origx
        while startx < endx:
            p1x = startx
            p1y = starty + p
            p2x = startx
            p2y = starty + (3 * p)
            p3x = startx + b
            p3y = starty + h
            p4x = startx + w
            p4y = starty + (3 * p)
            p5x = startx + w
            p5y = starty + p
            p6x = startx + b
            p6y = starty
            poly = [
                (p1x, p1y),
                (p2x, p2y),
                (p3x, p3y),
                (p4x, p4y),
                (p5x, p5y),
                (p6x, p6y),

        starty += yoffset

def radix_sort(nums):
    RADIX = 10
    placement = 1
    max_digit = max(nums)

    while placement < max_digit:
      buckets = [list() for _ in range( RADIX )]
      for i in nums:
        tmp = int((i / placement) % RADIX)
        buckets[tmp].append(i)
      a = 0
      for b in range( RADIX ):
        buck = buckets[b]
        for i in buck:
          nums[a] = i
          a += 1
      placement *= RADIX
    return nums

            return []

        row_ed=n-1        
        col_st=0
        col_ed=n-1
        current=1        
        while (True):
            if current>n*n:
                break
            for c in range (col_st, col_ed+1):
                matrix[row_st][c]=current
                current+=1
            row_st+=1
            for r in range (row_st, row_ed+1):
                matrix[r][col_ed]=current
                current+=1
            col_ed-=1
            for c in range (col_ed, col_st-1, -1):
                matrix[row_ed][c]=current
                current+=1
            row_ed-=1
            for r in range (row_ed, row_st-1, -1):
                matrix[r][col_st]=current
                current+=1
            col_st+=1
        return matrix

def find_platform(arr, dep, n): 
    arr.sort() 
    dep.sort() 
    plat_needed = 1
    result = 1
    i = 1
    j = 0
    while (i < n and j < n): 
        if (arr[i] <= dep[j]):           
            plat_needed+= 1
            i+= 1
        elif (arr[i] > dep[j]):           
            plat_needed-= 1
            j+= 1
        if (plat_needed > result):  
            result = plat_needed           
    return result

title: Challenge #853: Write a python function to find sum of odd factors...
description: Write a python function to find sum of odd factors of a number.
reference_solution:
import math
def sum_of_odd_Factors(n): 
    res = 1
    while n % 2 == 0: 
        n = n // 2 
    for i in range(3,int(math.sqrt(n) + 1)): 
        count = 0
        curr_sum = 1
        curr_term = 1
        while n % i == 0: 
            count+=1 
            n = n // i 
            curr_term *= i 
            curr_sum += curr_term    
        res *= curr_sum  
    if n >= 2: 
        res *= (1 + n) 
    return res

title: Challenge #895: Write a function to find the maximum sum of subseq...
description: Write a function to find the maximum sum of subsequences of given array with no adjacent elements.
reference_solution:
def max_sum_subseq(A):
    n = len(A)
    if n == 1:
        return A[0]
    look_up = [None] * n
    look_up[0] = A[0]
    look_up[1] = max(A[0], A[1])
    for i in range(2, n):
        look_up[i] = max(look_up[i - 1], look_up[i - 2] + A[i])
        look_up[i] = max(look_up[i], A[i])
    return look_up[n - 1]
